title: US monthly equity expiration (May 2027) — the hinge between 2027's longest and shortest opex cycles (25 sessions in, 18 out)
source: EST: third-Friday convention plus a Cboe contract-spec primary, both re-fetched direct by this event's own initial research on 2026-09-06 rather than inherited from the proposal. (1) ARITHMETIC: May 2027's Fridays are the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th, so the third Friday is 2027-05-21, and NYSE's own 2027 holiday column (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, re-fetched and parsed cell-by-cell this session) carries exactly one May 2027 closure — Memorial Day, Monday 2027-05-31 — which is ten days AFTER this date, so the expiration is unadjusted (unlike opex-2027-06-17, pulled to a Thursday by Juneteenth observed 2027-06-18). No NYSE early close falls in May 2027 either. (2) CONTRACT SPEC: www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after one 301, 1,731 bytes, re-fetched 2026-09-06) returns `VX,VX/J7,2027-04-21,21.0267`; Cboe's VX terms settle to the SOQ of the SPX/SPXW series expiring exactly 30 calendar days later, and 2027-04-21 + 30d = 2027-05-21. Running that same +30-day rule cold across all 14 VX rows the file carries reproduces every third-Friday expiration this calendar already tracks and invents none. WHY IT STAYS `estimate` AND NOT `confirmed`: the Cboe evidence dates the index-options leg by inference through a contract spec while this entry is a monthly expiration covering index AND single-stock options; theocc.com returned HTTP 403 to this runner again on 2026-09-06 (both the schedules page and the expiration-calendar media URL), Cboe's own options expiration-calendar PDF 403'd, and no VA (variance) row dates 2027-05-21 the way `VA,VA/F7,2027-01-15,298.25` and `VA,VA/M7,2027-06-17,319.25` directly date their months. `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED during the consumer-confidence-2027-05-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06) as proposals/opex-2027-05-21.from-consumer-confidence-2027-05-25.json, and made canonical here by this event's own initial research the same day (docs/research/events/opex-2027-05-21.md). ONE FIELD DELIBERATELY CHANGED FROM THE PROPOSAL: impact LOW -> MEDIUM. The proposal reasoned from actionability ('no house playbook is opex-keyed'), which is true and is true of every opex entry on this calendar; the tier this calendar actually runs is a CLASS tier, and it is clean at 8 of 9 — quarterly triple witchings are `high` (2026-09-18, 2026-12-18, 2027-03-19), ordinary monthlies are `medium` (2026-08-21, 2026-10-16, 2026-11-20, 2027-02-19, 2027-04-16), and opex-2027-04-16's own note states the convention verbatim ('Impact MEDIUM to match the other monthly expirations on this calendar, not because anything here is actionable'). This is an ordinary monthly, so it is medium. The single violation of that rule is opex-2027-06-17, a quarterly witching filed `low` by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 lane; that is a sibling lane's canonical file and is NOT edited here — flagged for its next pulse instead. WHAT THIS EXPIRATION ACTUALLY IS, measured this session rather than assumed. It is an ORDINARY MONTHLY, not a quarterly triple witching (the 2027 quarterlies are 03-19, 06-17, 09-17 and 12-17), so no index-futures leg, no S&P Select Sector rebalance MOC, and the closing-auction rebalance signature the Juneteenth lane measured on witching days (mean relative volume 2.25 across eight large caps against 1.01-1.09 on ordinary sessions of the same week) must NOT be assumed here. Its one distinguishing structural property is a cycle-length hinge: the 2027-04-16 -> 2027-05-21 cycle runs 35 calendar days / 25 trading sessions (tied longest of 2027) and the 2027-05-21 -> 2027-06-17 cycle runs 27 days / 18 sessions (the shortest of 2027 on both measures, and the only sub-28-day one, because Juneteenth observed 2027-06-18 pulls June's expiration to the Thursday). A 25-to-18-session step is the largest cycle-length drop across any single 2027 expiration. Not tradeable, and recorded so a later pulse does not mis-count the June roll. CORRECTION TO A BANKED RULE: opex-2027-04-16's leg 4 banked 'late-month FOMC -> opex is the last pre-blackout session; mid-month FOMC -> opex is INSIDE the blackout.' The first half holds; the second half is wrong, and this event is what exposes it, because May 2027 carries no FOMC meeting at all and so belongs to neither class. Running the Fed's own 2027 panel (Jan 26-27, Mar 16-17, Apr 27-28, Jun 8-9, Jul 27-28, Sep 14-15, Oct 26-27, Dec 7-8) with the full blackout rule — opens the second Saturday before the meeting, ENDS the Thursday following it, which is the half leg 4 never used — puts ZERO of 2027's twelve third Fridays inside a blackout. This repo's own entries already say so: fomc-blackout-start-2027-03-06's title reads 'through 2027-03-18' and opex-2027-03-19 is the day after it lifts. WHERE 2027-05-21 SITS: 22 days after the April blackout lifted (2027-04-29) and 8 days before the June one opens (fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29, estimate) — one of only two 2027 third Fridays in that position, with 2027-11-19, both being non-meeting months that precede an early-month meeting. So its five-session post-expiration week (2027-05-24 -> 2027-05-28, holiday-free) is the LAST Fed-communication window before the June SEP meeting — the exact mirror of opex-2027-04-16, whose post-expiration window is entirely Fed-silent. ADJACENCY: 3 sessions after vix-expiration-2027-05-18 (confirmed — the Juneteenth-displaced Tuesday settlement, which references 2027-06-17 and not this date), 4 days before consumer-confidence-2027-05-25 (medium, estimate), 7 before sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 (low, estimate), 8 before fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 (medium, estimate), 10 before memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 (low, estimate), and 6 after pjm-capacity-auction-2027-05 (medium, estimate). This date is itself the 30-day reference strip for VX/J7 (settled 2027-04-21 at 21.0267) — a property opex-2027-04-16's leg 2 already refuted as a distinction, since it is what every monthly expiration IS, and it is inherited here rather than re-derived. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry, and no house playbook is opex-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-06 for opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|pin, zero hits in both).
